text:
maya: Heads-up — Polaris QBR prep: embedding spend jumped ~3x this week, onboarding still at 60%. Need runway numbers before Thursday. Can we triage? :eyes:

eva: Onboarding update — live users at 62%, docs tech review done, still waiting on SSO and sample prompts from their ML team. ETA EOD Wed for SSO.

liam: Noted. The embedding surge aligns with a batch job they've started for similarity indexing. Asked infra to pause. pinged @polaris-ml.

josh: Quick forecast: current monthly run-rate $42k, embedding ops ~70% of that. If run continues, QBR projection $120k next quarter. I can draft a spend curve if we cap embeddings at 2M tokens/day.

maya: Can we set temporary token cap + alert? Need soft cap that notifies CSM and cust before hard throttle.

sam (pm): I'll own the alert workflow. Proposed rule:
```
rule: token_usage>1.8M/day
notify: #customer-success + maya + josh
action: send_email(customer@polaris.co, subject="Usage approaching limit")
```

liam: Also recommend prefix caching for their most common pipelines; estimate 30–40% token reduction.

josh: FYI billing-bot shows credits balance 18k left this month. If we apply cap, spend estimate falls to ~$58k/quarter.

billing-bot: [automated] Account Polaris: credits=18000; last charge=2026-02-28; next invoice 2026-03-31.

eva: I'll schedule an enablement with their ML lead tomorrow 10am PT to walk caching + rate limits. Can someone join to present cost playbook?

maya: I can join. Liam — can you prepare a 10-slide: 'Embeddings cost breakdown + caching levers'?

liam: Yup. Will push draft to shared drive by EOD.

josh: I'll produce the QBR cost slide with run-rate and capped scenario numbers.

maya: Action list: 1) temporary soft cap & alert (sam/josh) 2) pause batch job until enablement (liam) 3) enablement call + send playbook (eva/maya) 4) QBR cost slide (josh). Let's reconvene 11:30am Wed.

eva: noted. Adding to Polaris QBR doc and tagging team.

maya: thanks all :thumbsup:
